notes: Step ids, in this order: host, model, voice, robot, mr60, speaker, voiceprint, owner, quiet_hours.
state: ok | missing | skipped. fix: a one-line command or action, or null.
done: true once every step is ok or skipped; the app then opens Home instead of /setup.

POST /api/setup/{step} (JSON body depends on the step: {} to re-check, {"skip": true} to skip, {"heard": true} for speaker, the owner's {"name", "languages"} for owner, the quiet hours object for quiet_hours; {"play": true} for speaker plays the test first) answers the same object as this GET.
A step that is ok is ok even if it was skipped (the kit plugged in later). host cannot be skipped. 404 for an unknown step, 400 for a body the step does not take.
